Australia narrowly defeats Zimbabwe by one wicket in ODI

Australia secured a one-wicket victory over Zimbabwe in the third One-Day International (ODI) match in Harare on Sunday. Josh Inglis scored his second ODI century, and Nathan Ellis contributed his highest score in the format with an unbeaten 36 runs off 44 balls. Ellis was joined at the crease as Australia achieved the win with one ball remaining.
